title.en: An Act to Give to the Elementary School of Ajuy, Iloilo, the Name "Alejo Posadas Memorial School.

text.en:
The elementary school of the municipality of Ajuy, Province of Iloilo, shall hereafter be known
as "Alejo Posadas Memorial School," in honor of the late Alejo Posadas, a benefactor of said town.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1935.
